name: The Outlets at Orange
summary: The Outlets at Orange is a premier open-air outlet shopping center featuring over 120 brand-name stores, 25 restaurants, and unique entertainment options including an indoor skate park and IMAX cinema. This tree-lined destination combines exceptional shopping value with diverse dining and family-friendly entertainment in the heart of Orange County.
demographics: The Outlets at Orange attracts a diverse mix of value-conscious shoppers and families from Orange County and surrounding areas, with a strong representation of middle to upper-middle income households seeking brand-name merchandise at discounted prices. The center draws visitors across a wide age spectrum, from young adults to families with children who appreciate the entertainment amenities like the indoor skate park and IMAX cinema. The trade area encompasses both local Orange County residents and regional tourists who make destination shopping trips for the outlet experience, with typical visitors showing a preference for combining shopping with dining and entertainment activities.
description: The Outlets at Orange stands as one of Southern California's premier outlet shopping destinations, offering an exceptional blend of retail, dining, and entertainment in a beautifully designed open-air environment. Located at 20 City Boulevard West in Orange, California, this tree-lined outlet center features over 120 brand-name outlet stores where shoppers can find significant savings on their favorite brands. The center distinguishes itself from typical outlet malls by incorporating 25 diverse restaurants and eateries, providing visitors with an extensive array of dining options ranging from quick bites to sit-down meals. Beyond shopping and dining, The Outlets at Orange has become a true entertainment destination with its unique indoor skate park and state-of-the-art IMAX cinema, making it an ideal location for families and groups seeking a full day of activities. Managed by Simon Property Group, one of the nation's leading retail real estate companies, the center maintains high standards of quality and service while offering the value proposition that outlet shoppers seek. With its convenient Orange County location, ample parking, and thoughtfully curated mix of tenants, The Outlets at Orange has established itself as a must-visit destination for both local residents and tourists exploring Southern California.
